title: isinstance() tuple unpacking raises mypy internal error
body:
The tuple unpacking here ...
```
two_types = (list, tuple)                                                       
third_type = str                                                                
if isinstance('text', (*two_types, third_type)):                                
    print('hello')                                                              
```
